target_definition: Fixed absolute world positions, not shifted with the measured result
phase_prediction: User hypothesis: about 6% change per degree in center primary Fx; beyond roughly +/-6 degrees target tolerance may fail. No claim before measured results.
phase_changed_channel: X+ only; every other full-precision F10Q parameter frozen
perturbation_scope: Two deterministic rigid rotations about unchanged COM; not independent experimental samples; no projection
pair_peak_scope: Field-only pressure maxima on axis; potential traps, not proven 3D force equilibria or long-time transport
Y_screen_gate: Complete .5ms, positive +Y displacement, |Rg change| <=5%, one 2.1R component; select smallest Rg change among candidates with >=1nm projected 2ms motion, otherwise retain failure/weak-control result
Y_scope_rule: If near-field zero/efficiency loss confirmed, all Y statements HOMOGENEOUS_WATER_PROXY_SPECIFIC
initial_legality: Original sphere nonpenetration and cavity queries; reject invalid state without projection

admission_policy.distribution_definition: Hungarian squared-distance assignment of centered coordinates; no rotation; RMS/R; all common saved times
admission_policy.stop: A failures do not prevent B. Local+true geometry+true normal force balance required. First 3 QPs; <=5 only documented evidence. Fresh initial state for every trajectory.
admission_policy.group_scope: COM .02um is 26.7% of .075um target tolerance. Signal must exceed measured dt/cache differences; stationary OFF is a validated null, not control.
admission_policy.shape_control_cost: Navigation candidate endpoint Rg change <=5% and one connected component; otherwise explicitly report shape cost.
admission_policy.topology_scope: Full initial-network survival over 2ms and matched persistent events; instantaneous edge timing independently reported. Later events right-censored, not disproved.
admission_policy.initial: Unchanged manual near-contact 32-ID demo, not acoustic formation

candidate_design.method: bounded deterministic pressure-constrained primary COM proposal optimization, not surrogate evidence of navigation

admission_policy.numerical_scope: A/F frozen at x_n through each physical step; constraints/reactions updated at candidate x_{n+1}; no PBD, no spring, no repeated physical time.
admission_policy.reason: Frozen actual failure: true-normal force residual decreases 7.204e-12 -> 1.646e-13 -> 4.107e-15 N through three QPs, but original ~1.14e-16 N threshold still fails. Permit at most two further relinearizations, no tolerance changes.

switches: IDEAL_SCHEDULED_SEGMENTS; exact shortened step at nonaligned boundary; global coherent phase clock; no measured USB latency/quantization
sequence_stop: Compatibility before all new trajectories; short screens before full candidates; dt/cache repeats for admitted candidate groups only; stop on quality or wall-budget failure
